description: ADO-TXN client cache after rollback (read/write copy): a server keyset optimistic, a server static read-only, a client static optimistic and a client static batch-optimistic Recordset of SELECT ID, S FROM T ORDER BY ID are opened; BeginTrans; the Connection UPDATEs S of ID 1, the keyset and the client optimistic Recordsets edit and Update S of ID 2 and the batch Recordset edits S of ID 3 and calls UpdateBatch; each Recordset reads S of IDs 1-3 and RecordCount; RollbackTrans; each Recordset reads the same again without refresh, then after Resync(adAffectAll, adResyncAllValues), then after Requery; the stored rows through Execute. Asks what each cursor's cache shows after the transaction rolls back and which refresh restores the stored values.
